structure.unit: Professions and Occupations Regulated by the Department of Professional and Occupational Regulation and Boards Within the Department
Cemetery Operators, Perpetual Care Trust Funds and Preneed Burial Contracts

law.catch_line: Additional deposit not required upon subsequent sale of same grave, crypt or niche
law.text: If ten percent of the sales price of a grave or above-ground crypt or niche has been deposited in a perpetual care trust fund, no deposit shall be required on subsequent sales of the same grave, crypt or niche.
